No, that is not correct. In Switzerland, when voting by post, you must sign the voting certificate (or voting card) to validate the ballot. The signature on the voting certificate is a crucial part of the verification process to ensure that each vote is valid and that no one votes on behalf of another person without authorization.

The voting process in Switzerland is strictly regulated, and failing to sign the voting certificate would result in the ballot being invalid. Always follow the instructions provided with the voting materials to ensure your vote is counted.
